reports.notes:
Today Bennett crew of 11 excavated ,and backfilled 800' of 8" piping with 3 clean-outs with caps. From post screw pit to lagoon. Bennett to continue with 8" installation to lagoon on Monday, also going to install riser at drainage pipe inside fiber barn before rebar work starts next week by Blue Iron. Blue Iron crew of 8 completed concrete placement of south and west footings at fiber barn. After concrete pour was completed they started back on forming east wall of fiber barn. All tests passed before concrete placement.
Fiber barn south and west footing

subs.name: Sample taken: @55 y3
subs.items:
Total yardage placed 75.0.
MJE backfilled octagon pit for crane set up on Monday to install pumps in octagon mixing pits. Backfill at pit is 80% complete. I had Bennett install osf at backfill around octagons to prevent hazards of falling. Bennett hour 8.0 hours. Hayden hasn't sent me today's time card yet. Iron Horse hours worked 8.0.
Bennett and Iron Horse crew's along with Mje crew made really good progress today.

reports.notes: Today Bennett did not work. Iron Horse crew of 8 stripped concrete forms from yesterday's pour. Completed Dowels with extension with correct overlap at south and west walls at fiber barn along with installation of supports. Started forms on south exterior wall. 8.5 hours Boerger delivery today also. Iron Horse finished stripping all forms from north fiber barn wall and 2 men cleaning ﬂush/screen pit.

Bennett crew of 11 excavated the installed drain pipe under fiber barn pad and welded the Tee and fused collars and then backfilled. It's now ready for Iron Horse to form box around it. Also excavated west drain and did the same as above. Bennett installed conduit for water line penetration into fiber barn. They also excavated 200' of 8" piping from post screw to lagoon installed pipe and backfilled. Hayden gave permission to excavate through 4" water line that goes from pump to batch plant saying the location of water line is unknown and would take possibly two days to locate it. They will continue excavation tomorrow and install 45* and clean outs. When they hit said waterline they will repair immediately. Bennett welding crew of 9 showed up onsite and started facilitating and welding carbon steel piping. Iron Horse crew of 8 continues working on south and west wall forming and installed cutout for fan on east wall of fiber barn. I discovered over 1' of water in both ﬂush/screw pits and got iron horse start pumping water out so the can clean them out AGAIN. As of now I have no idea where it came from. I will find out first thing tomorrow morning. Mje crew excavated dump pit for ﬂume and started forming for concrete. Hayden informed me today that 6" needs to be removed from foundation pad for thickened concrete with sand below it. Bennett to excavate that tomorrow morning. I agree with Bennett time card. Bennett welding crew will likely be the same and that's agreeable. Met with Kansas Gas service today at riser Bennett will tie into. Russell,Edgar,Joseph, Dave and myself were there. Iron Horse working from 8-6 at 10 hours and that is correct. Bennett has ordered waterline pipe along with gas line pipe.
We had a very productive day onsite. I will make progress updates on plans tomorrow and submit with my report.

Bennett welding crew of 9 welding/fabrication of carbon steel pipes and fittings.
Bennett Const crew of 11 installed riser/fittings at west side of fiber barn (outside). Also excavated and installed 8" pipe to vault and installed clean out's and valve at location. Continued another 200' to next clean out location. Mje installed rebar/forms for dump pit and ﬂume. Bennett completed 6" of soil from fiber barn pad from north wall 52' to the south (per Hayden). Advanced Dairy service was onsite today but Matt Nelson directed them to install 60 hp pump in pit adjacent to milking Parlor crew of 2.
Iron Horse crew of 8 started interior wall forms on east,south and west walls of fiber barn and working to finish exterior forms at walls.also continue to pump water out of ﬂush/screen pits. Last night west octagon pit received 2' of water as well. Matt Nelson reported it's alright and there will be more coming due to ﬂushing and commissioning of pits and equipment adjacent to milking Parlor. Bennett time cards are correct. Also conducted safety meeting at 12:30pm.

Today iron horse crew of 8 continues to finish forming walls at fiber barn and poured concrete at drain location at fiber barn.
Bennett Const crew of 11 continues to excavate and install 8" waist water pipe. They got another 150' and had to stop due to leaving access for mje to relocate material and mje excavation work in the same area.
Hayden agreed it is a good idea to stop excavation at that point until tomorrow. Quality Dairy crew of 2 staged pumps/agitator's at octagon pit for install tomorrow. Mje crew of 10 poured concrete for foundation

subs.name: of ﬂush box and ﬂume
subs.items:
which was completed.
Dvo also made delivery today. Bennett welding crew of 9 working on fab/welding on carbon steel pipes and fittings. Time card are correct.

reports.notes: I haven't received any time card yet tonight. Both Bennett crews worked 10. Iron Horse crew worked 10. Dairy Depot worked 8. After hold up from mje work Bennett Const pot holed for second water line we found out was in are path again and located it. Then excavated 165' of 8" and installed and backfill. Bennett welding crew finished all random pipe/fittings welding. And will start facilitating for pipe connections at pumps as there installed tomorrow by Dairy Depot. Bennett Const should be able to finish 8" waist water line tomorrow or Saturday and start gas pipe excavation and install on Monday. Iron Horse completed all wall forms and supports at fiber barn and is ready for concrete pour tomorrow morning. Mje completed ﬂush box wall forms and is ready for concrete placement tomorrow morning also. Dairy depot will continue to install pumps at all pits tomorrow.

Bennett Const installed and backfilled all trench they had open of 8". Then they excavated installed and backfilled 400' of 8" from discharge vault passed the clean outs to the corner of lagoons. They will finish 250' of remaining 8" tomorrow morning. Also have gas line stretched out in place for install start tomorrow as well.
I had them move their equipment and lay down yard 200 yards to the west to make room for cattle trucks starting deliveries tomorrow morning. I then graded the same area removing all debris and ruts. Bennett welding crew finished all random welds and set up to start fabrication for carbon steel pipes and fittings for installed pumps at the pits tomorrow.
Dairy Depot installed 4 pumps at ﬂush/screen pit including fittings/ﬂanges. Also installed west pump at post screw pit with no ﬂanges installed yet. They will continue processing tomorrow morning. Mge completed concrete pour at walls of ﬂush box today and started forming ﬂume walls for concrete placement.
Iron Horse completed concrete pour of east, south and west walls to passing all tests. Including 4x4 box wall pour at drains for fiber barn. Total yardage of concrete poured was 170 yards. No work or corrections done today by Quality Dairy at electrical building.

Bennett Const crew of 12 excavated 8" pipe to vault until Hayden stopped crew. Hayden said there is a 30" pipe crossing and it will be a joint trench with 12" water line coming from the north adjacent to Hartman lay down yard. Hayden to help locate 30" line and coordinate joint trench with Bennett and 5G plumbing. Bennett welding fabrication of fittings to pumps until 1pm when they left site with bennett Const.
Iron Horse did not work today and will be back onsite on Tuesday.
Dairy Depot crew of 2 staged another pump at post screw press and the was re directed by Matt Nelson to pit #1 adjacent to milking parlor. Bennett Time cards are attached in pictures. Dairy Depot to catch up on time cards on Monday per Travis.

Dairy Depot crew of 2 has been onsite since 7:45am and haven't installed anymore pumps or agitators since yesterday. Matt Nelson re directed them to finish installation of pumps/agitators at ﬂush pit 1, at milking parlor. They came over to octagon pits to start work on Hartman installs and couldn't find the right pulleys for pumps at ﬂush/screen pit, 4 pumps that are installed already. We located the correct pulleys for the pumps and then Matt called them back to finish installing motors for pumps and make pipe connections on ﬂush pit
Cows will start arriving at 10pm tonight and needs his ﬂush pit operational. ... he has no plan B. DVO made delivery today as well. Dairy Depot respectfully is dropping the ball on Blue Sky and Hartman right now. Rudy and Travis are refusing to send help for Collin and his helper. I've been helping Matt Nelson in between helping him get ready for cows. Matt is very upset with there progress as am I. This is no fault of Collin and his helper. This problem is coming from lack of help from their management (per Matt Nelson and Ryan Dewitt. I have hope for better progress tomorrow as Matt's work will be completed tonight. Time cards for Dairy Depot will be sent to me on Monday (per David Jenkins). No time should be billed to Hartman for today.

Bennett Const crew of 11 work on backfill and compacted 8" waste water line that was installed last Friday and also trenched, installed and backfilled 825' of 4" gas line including riser at Kansas gas meter. They plan to finish up power poles west of octagons tomorrow. Bennett welding crew of 5 continues to fabricate pipping fittings for all pits and start installing and connecting to 6" and 8" headers at screen/ ﬂush pit tomorrow. Mje completed concrete pour of ﬂume walls today and stripped all forms from ﬂush box.
Iron Horse crew of 4 started at 11am and started stripping interior wall forms at fiber barn.
Dairy Depot completed ﬂush pit #1 for Blue Sky and started installing pumps/agitators at post ﬂush pit and octagons. Quality Dairy started erecting electrical building (3 walls).
Dairy Depot- 6.0 hours x2 men.
Bennett Const- 10 hours x11 men.
Iron Horse- 7 hours x 4 men.
Bennett welding-10 hours x 5 men.
Safety meeting was conducted at 12pm.
I agree with Bennett Time cards.

Bennett welding still finishing up for installation of pipe/fittings for headers at ﬂush/screen pit.
Bennett Const completed 8" piping from post screw to discharge vault at lagoon including the last clean out.
Also completed 2100' of 4" gas piping from Kansas Gas meter to power poles west of fiber barn and pits.
Iron Horse completed stripping all interior wall forms at fiber barn and started removing pins from forms on exterior walls of fiber barn.
Dairy Depot completed installing 9 pumps and 1 agitator at pits. Still need to mount motors.
Mje to start pumping water out of all pits tomorrow and discharge through newly installed 8" waist water pipe to lagoon.
Quality Dairy erecting electrical equipment building still. Cow count at the dairy is 950 head as of last delivery.
There is no bolted ﬂanges at clean outs for 8" line. It is all fusion welded. I suggest no air testing on this piping to prevent problems with clean outs being damaged from said test.
I have not received Dairy Depot time card yet.
Bennett Const- 10 hours x 12 men.
Bennett welding- 10 hours x 5 men.
Dairy Depot-9 hours x 3 men.
Iron Horse- 9 hours x 4 men. Snow is expected tonight into tomorrow.

The only sub that worked today was Dairy Depot crew of 2. We had trouble getting the telehandlers going this morning. The fuel had jelled because of sub zero temperatures. After putting warm fuel into them they ran normally. United Rentals showed up and replaced joy stick on big one and checked out the small one because it has low voltage reading on guages. The crew was setting second pump in screen pit and installing electric motors on pumps at post screw pit.
Bennett and iron Horse will be onsite tomorrow.

Bennett Const. Crew of 12. Completed 4" 90* weld and backfill from 800' run from KG supply meter at north end of project at O road. Excavated area at power poles to weld an connect 1" from 4" going south to DVO and 4" to 1" going to Fiber barn. Bennett graded all excavated area to provide safe travel of construction traffic. Bennett welding crew of 5 continues getting ready to install fittings/connections for all mixing pits.
Dairy Depot crew of 2 continued working on pumps at pits.

Bennett Const. Crew of 12. Excavated 1" gas pipe and 1" water line from bell hole at power poles to fiber barn.
Bennett welding is ready to start installing pipe fittings and connections at pits on Monday.

Bennett Const crew of 12 finished the gas pipe welding and reducers from 4" to 1" at bell hole under power poles one line going south and the other going east towards fiber barn and backfill. Water 1" water line is at S /E fiber barn wall with conduit installed into fiber barn for the pipe. They will complete the water line run to the North wall area of barn 3 and perform hot tie next week after these freezing temperatures stop.
Bennett welding crew of 6 working on fab/fittings for installation at all pits.
Dairy Depot crew of 2 working on finishing up installation of pumps and agitators. They have only 1 agitator left to install and 1 pump. We are missing 1 pump and 2 motors for pits. Matt Nelson re directed Dairy Depot to use them at the milking parlor ﬂush pit one. He talked to David Jenkins about it at that time. Mje removed all forms from ﬂush box/ﬂume today and completed backfilling. Iron Horse crew not onsite today. Safety meeting is attached in photos.
Snow day No work onsite today.

Bennett const. Crew of 11 shut down after 1.5 hours onsite due to snow on ground.
Bennett welding crew of 4 continues to get ﬂanges and fittings ready to go for complete installation next week.
Iron Horse is not onsite today. They are due to be here tomorrow (Saturday) and start rebar placement for foundation slab at fiber barn.
Dairy Depot crew of 1 is setting electrical motors and pulleys at pumps today. Collin with DD will have a helper starting tomorrow.
No work by Quality Dairy today at electrical building.

Dairy Depot crew of 2 has all pumps and agitators installed with electric motors. Tomorrow they will install and torque all pulleys and belts plus 90* ﬂanges at discharge ends. We also need locations for power packs installation at all pumps and agitators.
Bennett welding crew of 4 still fabricating pipes and fittings.
Mje removed all blankets from fiber barn and excavated 3-4" of mud out before moving in sand and leveling for rebar placement. No work was being done at electrical building by Quality Dairy. I've also again requested all time cards to be sent to David tomorrow or Monday morning. Skid steer wouldn't run with enough power to do any mud removal. Called united and they will be out Monday morning.

• Iron horse removed wall forms from south, east and west walls.
• Dairy Depot Cutting Pipe for air valves. And welding

Iron Horse crew of 5 cleaning up around the footing of south wall at fiber barn. Mje finished placing the sand and grading. Then Iron Horse crew started placing rebar and plan on finishing tomorrow. Scheduled concrete pour for slab is Wednesday 02.06.25.
Bennett welding crew of 6 are bringing welded fittings/pipe to ﬂush pit header.. Bennett const crew of 10 does the installation from this point. I will ask Russell for a schedule update for 6 day's tomorrow morning.
Today's safety meeting is attached in photos. Collin from dairy depot was onsite for 2 hours today. Collin stated he has a meeting today , plus needed to go to Garden City. Said he would be back onsite Wednesday morning.
I will update the progress plan for Wednesday Raken report. we can keep on schedule this week and make next week a little easier is the plan.

Today Bennett const crew of 12. 1 lg Cat excavator was picked up from site today. They used 1 large cat excavator to secure large 3" pump and siphon hose, to pump out octagon pits. The discharge from octagon pits is going to the screen/ﬂush pit. From there the water is draining down 30" pipe and discharged into lagoon. This method of de watering is very slow.
The rest of the crew worked on installing the gas line/water line into the fiber barn and into place before tomorrow's concrete pour. Including backfilling that s/e area.
Hayden had Bennett const. Excavate and remove @3" of sand along the footing of the north wall and @6' out.
Bennett welding crew of 6 continues to make fabrication to all piping/fittings to complete the job. Seems to take a very long time to this type of work.
Dairy Depot crew of 2 completed everything they could with all equipment. Dave and I spoke with Collin and he said he needs a week notice if possible and he'll be here to help. He will be there for commissioning as well. Bennett Const told Dairy Depot that they would move the one pump and adjust one agitator.
Iron Horse crew of 6 continued to place rebar and dowels/ties. They say they'll be ready for concrete tomorrow. I've asked Collin with Dairy Depot many days now for him to get Dave all the missing time cards.

I left at 12pm today for an appointment in Dodge City. Concrete pour starting at 1pm. David going out to site to cover for me noticing rebar dowels in the wrong location. Transposed in relationship to plan details. He had iron Horse crew correct it before pouring concrete. Also brought to my attention was s/w man door is to small and not per spec. Bennett Const. Crew of 10 finished backfill of water and gas lines at s/corner of fiber barn. Also stubbed gas line out at west side. Bennett welding crew of 5 continues to weld and fabricate.

Today Bennett const. Crew of 11 worked on fitting and piping installation at screen/ﬂush pits. Bennett also continued pumping out octagons. It looks to be around 4' deep when I left the site at 3pm.
Bennett welders crew of 5. Worked on welding headers for octagons.
Iron Horse crew of 6 showed up onsite at 12:15pm and started doweling work for interior walls. Friday is scheduled to keep fitting pipe at the pits. Joe is leaving for Colorado @3am and meeting Dairy Depot at a halfway point. Joe is returning (7) 6" check valves. Joe is picking up (7) 8" check valves from Dairy Depot driver. This will keep the Bennett crew on schedule to finish piping early next week.

Bennett const crew of 11 fitting pipes and fittings at screen/ﬂush pits and pumping out octagons. I moved dirt from area between barn 3 and screen/ﬂush pits to make room for equipment access. Bennett welding crew of 6 working on header welding for octagons.
Iron Horse crew of 8 working on dowels and forms for interior walls of fiber barn. Concrete pour for fiber barn interior walls scheduled for Sunday 3.2.25.
